packageRules.description: react, react-dom, and @tn4consulting/shared-ui-scds-core must move together across every mfe-pot app repo — they're federation-shared singletons (see mfe-pot-platform/CLAUDE.md's federation-sharing policy). A partial bump here reproduces the exact silent-runtime-mismatch problem the shared-singleton contract exists to prevent, since Native Federation's version check has no compile-time enforcement across separate repos. @gcds-core/components was removed from this group when GCDS was removed from the family entirely.
